brief: A Haryana-bagh-inspired counted-thread tile: a 64x64 grid of 4-px stitch cells fully covered by nested yellow-and-orange lozenges (each large lozenge split into three concentric bands, innermost split into four squares), D4 symmetry on the grid, a zig-zag row of small white lozenges along each border, red ground visible only as 1-cell outlines, maximum five colours.
